_source: dimensions measured from assets/robots/own_mecanum/stl (scripts/tools/analyze_wheel_mesh.py + wheel centers of the assembly STL), 2026-09-30
_assumptions: masses guessed (2026-09-30): robot ~3 kg in total, ~350 g per wheel incl. motor -> rotating wheel 0.1 kg (PLA hub 55 g + 9 rubber-coated rollers with metal pins, 5 g each), motor + mount 0.25 kg counted in the chassis (2.6 kg); rigid chassis (no pendulum axle)
_chassis: chassis = Fusion 360 export base_link.stl (MecanumRobot_orientalt_v2_description_Bencenek), rotated 180 deg about z (CAD front = -x), origin 64.8 mm below the bounding-box center; COM and inertia from the Fusion export (1.53 kg), scaled to the guessed 2.6 kg incl. motors
